_what: Where the execution surface actually lives, measured across every MCP-visible BattleGrid surface on 2026-08-28. Prompted by the user's recollection that risk/reward is configured at AGENT creation rather than on the strategy. All reads read-only; no write tool was called.

verdict.the16ExecutionParameters: STRATEGY-owned. All 16 (minAtrPct, minRiskRewardRatio, min/maxStopLossAtrMultiple, trailing x4, breakEven x2, timeDecay x6) are fields of the strategy object: the compile_strategy_plan CREATE/UPDATE schemas accept them, the viable compile's postState carries them, and a live tuned strategy (TRAJ-03 rev 7) stores real values for every one. None of them appears in the agent create/update schemas, in either of two live agent reads, in the deployment-policy schema, or in the radar-deployment schema.
verdict.whatTheAgentOwns: Capital and order-execution limits: minAllocationUsd, maxDailyTrades, balanceThresholdUsd, maxLeverage, maxSlippageBps, maxConcurrentExposureUsd, maxCumulativeDrawdownUsd, maxDailyLossUsd, positionSizePresets{small,medium,largePct} - plus read-only strategyTimeframe/regimeTimeframe derived at bind. These ARE risk settings, which is the likely root of the recollection: capital risk is agent-side; trade-shape risk (R:R, stops, trailing, break-even, decay) is strategy-side.
verdict.userRecollectionAssessment: Half right. 'There are settings you can set up at agent creation' - yes, the capital block above, supplied as tradingConfig on create_intelligence_agent. 'Risk reward is based on the agent creation part' - contradicted for minRiskRewardRatio specifically: on the MCP surface it lives on the strategy (TRAJ-03 carries 1.5; no agent surface accepts or returns it).

platformDefaults_fromCompilePostState._source: compile_dry_run_2026-08-28-small.json responseVerbatim.approvedPlan.postState - the viable CREATE compile sent NONE of the 16, so these are the values the platform fills in. ONE data point: one CREATE, 1h anchor; whether defaults vary by timeframe or anything else is unmeasured.
platformDefaults_fromCompilePostState._note: TRAJ-03 differs from these defaults in exactly three fields: minAtrPct 0.8 vs 0.5, trailingTriggerR 0 vs 1, trailingGivebackPct 25 vs 45 - consistent with three knobs deliberately tuned on an otherwise-default strategy.

agentReads._source: get_intelligence_agent on two different live agents, tradingConfig keys verbatim
agentReads._note: identical key sets, different values; no execution parameter and no nested positionManagement in either

evidence.agentWriteSchemas: create_intelligence_agent / update_intelligence_agent tradingConfig: additionalProperties false, exactly the nine capital fields above (strategyTimeframe/regimeTimeframe explicitly read-only and rejected on write). No R:R, ATR gate, stop, trailing, break-even, or decay field.
evidence.deploymentPolicySchema: upsert_deployment_policy: game participation only (agent slot, minConfidence, session/regime conditions); its own description says a slot 'carries no trade permission' and that the schema REJECTS tradingEnabled/minConviction/coinRules.
evidence.radarDeploymentSchema: upsert_radar_deployment: standing per-coin trade authority - agent slot, minConviction bar, hours/regime conditions, deploymentTimeframe. No execution parameters.

discrepanciesObserved._why: These are the likely source of the confusion - agent-facing surfaces still TALK about risk/ATR while no agent field carries them.
discrepanciesObserved.1_createProseVsSchema: create_intelligence_agent's tradingConfig description says it includes 'ATR preferences, and nested positionManagement'; the schema (additionalProperties: false) accepts neither, and neither appears in an agent read.
discrepanciesObserved.2_catalogPresetsMissing: get_trading_config_catalog's description promises 'position-management presets (COLT/BERETTA/LUGER/WALTHER)'; the response contains only tradingDefaults{defaults, bounds} - no presets block.
discrepanciesObserved.3_twoDifferentBoundsForTheSameKnobs: The agent-facing catalog bounds ATR 0.1-10 and R:R 0.5-3; the strategy compile schema bounds minAtrPct 0.01-50 and leaves minRiskRewardRatio unbounded. Which bound the validator actually enforces on a strategy write is UNMEASURED - settling it needs a compile probe with an out-of-catalog-bounds value, not run today.
discrepanciesObserved._inference: LABELLED INFERENCE, not measurement: the catalog's own note - '(Signal presets are retired - the signal-gate/stop-loss/R:R fields are set directly)' - plus this residue reads like these settings migrated from an agent-side preset system to direct strategy fields, with the agent-facing prose/catalog not fully swept.

addendum_sameDay_tradableUniverse._what: Read-only follow-up: list_radar_deployments + list_deployment_policies, answering the 'where does a strategy's tradable universe live' open question from the compile record.
addendum_sameDay_tradableUniverse.answer: The autonomous-trading universe is the set of per-coin RADAR deployments, not a strategy field. This account: 20 coins deployed (at the coinCap of 20), each binding one agent at a deploymentTimeframe; 0 arena deployment policies. The compile request's coinSelection scoped only the review.
addendum_sameDay_tradableUniverse.liveEvidenceTheRiskGatesActPerTrade: radar resolvesNow rows carry qualificationBlock values AGGREGATE_BELOW_MIN (most coins) and ATR_VOLATILITY_BELOW_MIN (BTC, HYPE). The names map onto the strategy's minAggregateScore and minAtrPct gates refusing ENTRY QUALIFICATION on a live coin - direct observational support that the 16 execution parameters act at the individual-trade level, not the deployment level. The name-to-field mapping is inference from the reason-code names; the codes themselves are verbatim.
addendum_sameDay_tradableUniverse.fleetStateObservedInPassing: 12 of 15 active agents are AGENT_HALTED (since 2026-08-25..27), blocking 13 of the 20 radar coins; 2 coins in position (FARTCOIN, ETH), 5 scanning. Recorded as observed state only - no agent was touched.

honestLimits: MCP connector surface only. The BattleGrid web UI was not inspected; if its agent-creation wizard displays R:R/stop settings, it may be writing them to the strategy behind the scenes - unverifiable from here.
Platform defaults measured from ONE CREATE compile at a 1h anchor.
Two agents read out of 23; their write schemas corroborate the shape, but per-agent variation beyond those schemas cannot be fully excluded.
No write probe was run to test which ATR/R:R bounds the validator enforces.
